INSERT INTO handle_producer_block (
                host_chain_id,
                handle,
                producer_block_number,
                producer_block_hash
            )
            SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM handle_bridged_events
                 WHERE dst_handle = $2 AND dst_chain_id = $1
             )
            ON CONFLICT (host_chain_id, handle, producer_block_hash) DO NOTHING
